Our Story

A firm built for
the long term

Founded in New York in November 2017, RADIANX CAPITAL was established to close the gap between institutional investment management and private wealth — bringing genuine analytical rigor, transparent pricing, and unwavering fiduciary commitment to discerning clients.

Over eight years, we have grown to manage nearly $1 billion in assets while maintaining the operational discipline, selectivity, and personal attention that define who we are. Our clients are not account numbers — they are long-term partners.

We are registered with the SEC (No. 801-117100), held to the highest regulatory standards, and bound by an absolute fiduciary duty to every client we serve.

What We Stand For

Our core
principles

These principles are not aspirational statements posted on a wall. They are the operational standards by which every client relationship, every investment decision, and every internal process is conducted.

01
Fiduciary Obligation
We are legally and morally bound to act solely in your best interest. There are no proprietary products to push, no referral fees to chase — just expert counsel aligned entirely with your outcomes.
02
Disciplined Precision
Every portfolio, every plan, every recommendation is constructed with methodological rigor. We measure what matters, we stress-test our assumptions, and we never confuse activity with progress.
03
Long-Term Thinking
Wealth is not built in a quarter. We make decisions based on your long-term financial architecture — not short-term market noise, not performance chasing, not calendar-driven activity.
04
Radical Transparency
Our fee structures are straightforward and disclosed upfront. Our communications are direct. You will always know the reasoning behind every recommendation we make.
05
Selectivity
We maintain a deliberately limited client roster. This allows us to deliver the depth of attention each relationship deserves — and to hold every client to the same high standard of partnership.
06
Regulatory Integrity
SEC registration is not a formality — it is a commitment. We embrace the full scope of our regulatory obligations as a baseline, not a ceiling, for how we conduct business.

Firm History

Eight years
of measured growth

From founding to nearly $1 billion under management — a progression built on trust, not marketing. Each milestone reflects a deepening of client relationships, not a departure from them.

November 2017
Founded in New York
RADIANX CAPITAL, LLC is established in New York City by Li Tan and David Su, with a founding mandate to deliver institutional-grade investment management to private clients.
2018
SEC Registration
The firm achieves full registration as a Registered Investment Adviser with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under No. 801-117100, establishing its fiduciary framework.
2019 — 2021
Selective Client Growth
Assets under management grow steadily as the firm builds a concentrated roster of high-net-worth clients through direct referral. Growth is deliberate — quality of relationship over quantity of accounts.
2022
Team Expansion
Douglas Beyer joins the firm as Investment Adviser and Analyst, strengthening the firm's analytical capacity and enabling deeper research-driven portfolio management for existing clients.
2024 — 2025
Approaching $1 Billion AUM
RADIANX CAPITAL reaches approximately $953 million in assets under management — a milestone that validates the firm's disciplined approach to long-term wealth stewardship.
Regulatory Standing

Full disclosure.

Our regulatory status is available in full through the SEC's Investment Adviser Public Disclosure system. We encourage prospective clients to review our Form ADV, which details our business practices, fee structures, and any relevant disciplinary history.

Transparency is not a marketing position at RADIANX CAPITAL — it is a regulatory obligation we embrace completely.
